name: Legend of the Willow
source:
This story follows a young woman who is learning to become a Geisha in a fictional world inspired by feudal Japan, but that also includes cultural elements from other Asian countries. 

During an intimate ritual Mei accidentally transforms into a fox discovering that she is a Kitsune. Now she will have to learn how to control her new magic ability while being chased by humans and other mysterious forces.

[From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Legend_of_the_Willow]romance-club.fandom[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕一位正在学习成为艺伎的年轻女子展开。舞台是一个以日本封建时代为灵感、同时融入其他亚洲国家文化元素的架空世界。

在一次私密仪式中，梅意外变成了狐狸，才发现自己竟是狐妖。如今，她必须在遭到人类与其他神秘势力追逐的同时，学会控制这份新觉醒的魔法力量。

[摘自[url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Legend_of_the_Willow]romance-club.fandom[/url]]
